# Proset CE — open-source AI voice notes recorder

> Proset CE is a memory helper: the self-hostable, open-source AI voice notes
> recorder that makes sure you never lose or forget a vital idea. Bring your
> own AI key and run it on your own server.

## Important URLs

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Schoedel-Design-AI/proset-community): source, issues, contributing
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Schoedel-Design-AI/proset-community/main/README.md): quickstart and hosted-vs-CE comparison
- [Developer API + MCP docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Schoedel-Design-AI/proset-community/main/docs/architecture/developer-api.md): REST + MCP for AI agents on your own instance
- [Hosted Proset](https://proset.ai/): the managed version — cloud sync, supported AI pipeline
- [Hosted Proset details](https://proset.ai/llms-full.txt): full product description

## About

Proset CE is the open core of Proset, a voice notes recorder that turns spoken
thoughts into polished tasks, emails, and summaries. Record → transcribe
(bring-your-own AI key) → act on the result. Web + Android, English + Spanish,
Apache-2.0.
